_meta.note: Greenfield module (spec's own words: 'everything below is design, not a discovered wiring gap'). Two starting cases picked against ALREADY-TRACKED MatchSnapshot fields (PlantCount/ZombieCount) rather than inventing new state-tracking infrastructure (e.g. a wave counter) that this module's own scope does not ask for. Every number here is a genre-appropriate STARTING VALUE, not a validated balance decision -- matches this repo's own established 'pick starting values, tune from play' precedent (T2.11's own phased-rollout decision, cited by creature-lawn-deploy-plan.md's own Risks table). maxFiresPerRun=1 and fireChanceMilli=300 (30%) per case are deliberately conservative starting points: a genuinely rare, noteworthy moment rather than a constant nag. No souls/resource cost is charged to trigger a deploy (plan's own Gates section default, 'no cost beyond the frequency cap itself').
